declarations.name: toDate
declarations.description: Reads a `Date`, a timestamp in milliseconds or an ISO 8601 string; anything else is `undefined`.

declarations.name: formatRelativeTime
declarations.description:
Phrases the distance between `date` and `now` in the largest unit that fits: "now", "42 seconds ago",
"in 3 hours", "yesterday", "2 weeks ago", "last year". Values are rounded to the nearest unit.

declarations.name: nextChangeIn
declarations.description: Milliseconds until `formatRelativeTime(date, now)` reads differently, so a live display redraws only when needed.

Time relative to now, such as "3 minutes ago" or "in 2 days", that keeps itself current. The phrase comes from
`Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` in the element's `locale` (else the nearest `lang` attribute, else the browser's language),
picks the largest unit that fits and redraws exactly when the rounded value changes, so a page full of timestamps
costs one timer each and no polling. The full date and time is the inner `<time>` element's `datetime` and its
hover title.

`date` takes an ISO 8601 string or a timestamp in milliseconds in markup, and a `Date` as a property. Until it holds
a valid date the element shows its default slot, for a fallback such as "Never".
declarations.name: RelativeTime

cssProperties.description: Colour of the phrase; inherits the surrounding text colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-relative-time--color

cssProperties.description: Digit style; tabular digits keep a ticking value from shifting the text after it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-relative-time--font-variant-numeric

cssProperties.description: Whether the phrase may wrap between its words.
cssProperties.name: --c2-relative-time--white-space

cssParts.description: The `<time>` element holding the phrase, with the machine-readable `datetime` and the full date as its title.
cssParts.name: time

slots.description: Fallback content shown while `date` is unset or not a valid date.

members.name: date
members.description: The moment to describe: an ISO 8601 string or a millisecond timestamp in markup, or a `Date` from script.

members.name: format
members.description: Length of the phrase: `long` ("3 minutes ago"), `short` ("3 min. ago") or `narrow` ("3m ago" in some locales).

members.name: numeric
members.description: `auto` uses words such as "yesterday", "tomorrow" and "now"; `always` keeps a number ("1 day ago").

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale of the phrase and the full date. Empty uses the nearest `lang` attribute, then the browser's language.

members.name: noUpdate
members.description: Draw the phrase once and stop updating it as time passes.
